captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a mechanical vehicle suspension component, specifically a twist-beam rear axle. It features a dark grey, C-section torsion cross-beam connecting two parallel trailing arm sections. At the front, the trailing arms terminate in blocky chassis mounting brackets designed for horizontal revolute joints. At the rear tips of the trailing arms, light grey cylindrical wheel hubs are mounted on revolute axles.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a twist-beam rear axle suspension. It should feature a central C-section torsion cross-beam connecting two trailing arms, chassis mounting brackets on horizontal revolute joints at the front, and cylindrical wheel hub axles on revolute joints at the rear tips.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a fixed chassis mount. It models the trailing arms using rectangular boxes and links them to the chassis mount using a revolute joint. The central torsion cross-beam is modeled by subtracting an inner box from a larger box to form a C-channel profile, which is then joined to the trailing arms. Finally, cylindrical wheel hubs are created using cylinder primitives and attached to the rear tips of the trailing arms with revolute joints.
